# Synthetic 3D fixtures

`tests/helpers/glb_factory.py` creates a small, embedded-resource triangle GLB
and optional PNG/JPEG textures on demand. The fixtures contain no customer
assets and are deliberately small so parser boundary tests stay fast.

Human-reviewed golden renders are generated by the 20-case acceptance suite and
are stored in its output directory rather than committed as product inputs.
Automated image checks verify file readability, dimensions and non-blank pixels;
they do not claim to judge visual composition.
